One Region, 220+ Communities

HorizonLayout.body: We are a social impact startup committed to empowering the artisans of Northeast India by showcasing their authentic handwoven textiles and crafts to the world. Our products are ethically sourced from rural women artisans associated with Self-Help Groups (SHGs) across the region — this platform exists so that they receive fair value for their craft, directly.
